title: E-QTM-0144: what one history records under net records: with the fear beat on, a classical member of the knot is a...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0144 in the quantum arena: what one history records under net records: with the fear beat on, a classical member of the knot is a signed spread after its first meeting, and at in-model settings it often records a spread of outcomes or a negative count on its own; every Bell violation needs such members, so net records give definite outcome statistics for the ensemble, not a definite outcome for each history.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
